rules.accounts: An account is listed only after the live page was checked against the constituent (name, and platform ID where one exists). YouTube, BitChute and Rumble accounts are pinned by channel ID; the Rumble channels all carry Rumble's verified badge. BitChute has no verification badge, so those channels are matched on name and profile only. X accounts are pinned by X's numeric user ID after the profile's display name was checked against the constituent; a handle still marked `unverified` has not been read yet.
rules.adjacent: Profiled as a conspiracy propagandist, a male-supremacist influencer, or a large-audience commentator documented as platforming core figures. Weight 0.5.
rules.core: Profiled chiefly for white-nationalist, neo-Nazi, antisemitic or militia/accelerationist activity. Weight 1.0.
rules.exclusions: Sitting officials and current candidates; figures whose audience is mostly non-political (entertainers, athletes); policy-advocacy organisations.
rules.inclusion: A constituent enters the extremism basket only if a monitoring organisation (SPLC, ADL) has published a profile or report documenting it, recorded under `basis`. The labels are those organisations' characterisations, not findings of this project.
